ruling: Method-kernel package is an index over statistical, causal, signal, graph, forecasting, optimization and related formalisms; each method imports its own assumptions/identifiability/evaluation authority and can emit findings only, never business decisions.
No common data-shape semantic authority exists; all 33 candidate shapes route to native domain/representation authorities through p01-data-shape-authority-map.jsonl.

Connector contracts own provider-neutral capability/admission/change/delivery surfaces and import protocol-specific schemas from ADBC/OpenAPI/MCP/etc.; authentication, transport, source-domain truth and provider qualification remain external.
Visual grammar, accessibility, semantic query/metric meaning, disclosure, publication and interaction state are separate authorities; presentation never mints metric or business meaning.

Separate study/experiment identity, assignment/exposure, outcome cut, statistical/causal method, analysis result, review and decision. Experimental evidence may support but never itself authorize rollout or business action.
Forecast definition, method/evaluation, edition/provenance and selection/override/publication governance remain separate.
CRS, feature/geometry, raster/grid, moving feature/trajectory, point cloud and analytical findings route to distinct OGC/ISO/native authorities; workflow/publication remains composition.
SKOS concept schemes/mappings, OWL ontologies, ISO11179 metadata registries, DCAT catalogs and independent code/master/certification lifecycles remain distinct.
W3C PROV propositions, OpenLineage observations, authenticated attestations, verification, appraisal and acceptance are different epistemic layers.

Domain/event meaning, message envelope, transport/session, delivery occurrence, acknowledgement, retry/idempotency and business-effect receipt are distinct. Transport success never upgrades to domain success.
Decision/objective policy, exact optimization, heuristics, queueing and simulation have separate formalism owners and evidence strengths; selected business action remains external.
Model/agent/tool protocols are optional replaceable ports; protocol task/session/component state cannot become enterprise fact, authorization or business effect authority.

Value/column representation, table/snapshot/transaction semantics, catalog identity, object storage, query execution and provider occurrence are distinct; Arrow representation and Iceberg table semantics cannot substitute for each other or for provider qualification.

Logical graph, window/watermark/time, trigger, execution occurrence, checkpoint/backpressure/retry and output publication remain distinct; pipeline completion is not business commit or downstream acceptance.
Commercial/customer/billing/payment/support lifecycles compose but do not own platform estate/tenant/account identity, supplier exit or maintenance; those are imported authorities.

Feature/target definition, fitted model artifact, evaluation/calibration, model edition, serving occurrence, monitoring/drift and decision threshold/action authority remain separate; ONNX/serialization never owns predictive meaning.

Quality observation/assertion and rule evaluation are distinct from reconciliation match/discrepancy/resolution and from control/correction authority; analytical quality finding cannot silently mutate records.

Semantic query intent, typed/logical IR, optimization/physical plan, provider execution, result occurrence and materialization/cache identity remain distinct; Substrait/Arrow representations do not own semantic metric or storage truth.

JSON/CBOR/Protobuf/Avro/Arrow and other codecs own representation/profile semantics only; serialization, framing, compression and canonicalization cannot create domain identity, authority or equality not supplied by the semantic contract.

Resource capability/request, admission/authorization, reservation/lease, scheduling, observed usage, pressure/eviction and cost are distinct; runtime interface support never implies resource authority.

Identity, authentication, authorization, delegation/revocation, privacy purpose/consent, cryptographic protection, secrets/key custody, workload identity, attestation/evidence and risk/appraisal are separate authorities with explicit transitions.

Metric semantic identity, dimensions/grain, units/currency, formula AST, aggregation/summarizability, time/calendar, query/materialization and disclosure remain distinct; visualizations and analytical results consume but cannot redefine metrics.

Shared foundations are only small reusable primitives with native authorities; business calendar, money, probability and verification-receipt misplacements are re-homed and universal status requires cross-domain stability without hidden policy.
